exit.max_hold_intent: SCHEDULED_AT_ENTRY; because the time-based exit is known prospectively, its predefined 24th synchronized executable H1 close may be used as the Discovery OHLC exit proxy
exit.mean_cross_condition: first completed synchronized bar after entry where z_log_ratio_120 crosses or reaches 0 relative to the active relationship side
exit.mean_cross_detection: Evaluate z_log_ratio_120 only after a synchronized H1 bar is completed and its close is causally available.
exit.mean_cross_exit_intent_time: the close timestamp of the completed synchronized bar that first reveals the mean-cross
exit.mean_cross_missing_or_closed_session: keep exit intent pending and fill at the first later valid synchronized executable event; relationship remains active until fill

rationale: Frozen CADJPY/EURJPY log-ratio reversion proxy; hypothesis tests relative-value mean reversion without fitted beta.

stage_a_economic_unit.cashflow_conversion_rule: Convert each quote-currency PnL/cost cashflow to EUR with the causal quote-to-EUR rate available at that cashflow timestamp; entry-notional normalization uses the entry timestamp rate. If a required causal conversion is unavailable, do not open the outcome.
stage_a_economic_unit.conversion_basis: causal quote-currency-to-EUR conversion available at or before synchronized entry; if unavailable the economic outcome remains blocked until M6 attaches a deterministic conversion rule/evidence
stage_a_economic_unit.cost_scaling_rule: Apply frozen per-leg spread/commission/swap/conversion rules to each exact analytic leg quantity and sum leg costs/PnL at relationship level. Any nonlinear or fixed cost that cannot be deterministically mapped keeps cost state UNRESOLVED.
stage_a_economic_unit.entry_price_basis: candidate synchronized entry MARKET_PROXY price for each leg
stage_a_economic_unit.equal_absolute_unit_notional_definition: For legs i=1,2, abs(q_i) * entry_price_i_quote_per_base * causal_quote_to_eur_rate_i_at_entry = 500 EUR exactly; therefore sum_i absolute_entry_notional_eur = 1000 EUR.
stage_a_economic_unit.executable_volume_fact_rule: No lot/min/step/max is silently assumed in Stage A; executable-volume constraints belong to realizability/Stage B unless an applicable cost rule explicitly requires them, in which case the missing fact must be resolved before outcome.
stage_a_economic_unit.normalization_rule: Both legs are independently normalized to the same 500 EUR absolute entry notional; no beta, volatility, allocator or post-outcome weight is applied.
stage_a_economic_unit.quantity_formula: For each leg i: abs_base_units_i = 500 / (entry_price_i_quote_per_base * causal_quote_to_eur_rate_i_at_entry); direction assigns the sign.
